visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men are in a modern indoor studio with wooden cabinets and warm lighting. One man wearing a blue t-shirt with a 'WALSALL' logo and a silver chain stands and talks expressively. The other man, wearing glasses and a cream t-shirt, sits at a desk with his hand on his chin, looking skeptical. (2) The scene cuts between close-ups of the two men as they engage in a back-and-forth dialogue. The seated man adjusts his glasses and shifts his posture while the standing man continues to gesture broadly with his hands. (3) The seated man at the desk suddenly reacts with high intensity, throwing his head back and screaming toward the ceiling in a comedic, exaggerated manner while sitting in front of a laptop. (4) The setting shifts to an outdoor park area with bright natural daylight and green trees. The man in the blue shirt stands next to a lime green electric scooter, holding a smartphone and pointing at the screen. (5) The man in the blue shirt opens the storage compartment of the scooter to reveal a helmet and a small blue scent card. He brings the helmet to his nose to smell it, smiling widely. (6) The man in the cream shirt is now wearing the white helmet and sitting on the lime green scooter. He looks at the camera while the other man explains features. (7) The man in the cream shirt rides the scooter away down a long urban street under a highway overpass, filmed from a distance in a long shot. The man in the blue shirt remains standing in the foreground, watching him go with a stunned expression.
